info.description: Endpoints for the RAG Express app. Set `baseUrl` to where the server runs (default http://localhost:3000).

request.description: Connects to MongoDB and inserts a test document into rag_doc.docs.
Parses the first two pages of ./docs/policy.pdf, creates embeddings per line and stores them in rag_doc.docs.
Returns the embedding for the text "Hello World".
Starts a new session (no sessionId) and answers the message using vector search over the loaded document.
Continues an existing session. Set the `sessionId` collection variable to an _id from the rag_doc.sessions collection.
